parameters.content:
## podcast-standing-check

Precheck workflow for podcast system. Part of podcast approval gate.

### What it does
Validates client podcast approval status before workflow executes.

### Called by
Podcast engine. Returns approval status to gate system.

### Returns
Calls fleet-system-standing-check with system="podcast"
